name: Arjun Verma
bio:
Arjun's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for engineering, nurtured by his father, a mechanical engineer. He quickly excelled in his studies, earning a degree in mechanical engineering with a focus on high-performance vehicles. After graduating, Arjun gained invaluable experience at a local tuning shop and then a Formula Student team where he honed his skills in vehicle dynamics and team management. 

He approaches his role as Head of Operations with a meticulous attention to detail and a drive for efficiency. Arjun believes in fostering a collaborative environment where data-driven decisions are key. His technical knowledge combined with his knack for problem-solving makes him a valuable asset to any racing team. He is known for his ability to streamline processes and optimize performance, always striving for continuous improvement.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Arjun is of average height with a lean build and an intense gaze.
